item.title: Version 0.6.3
item.description:
What's New

  • Schemes: save a display's whole setup — wallpaper, overlays and every setting — and apply it to any display. Bookmarks go back to being just a favourite wallpaper; applying one no longer touches the target's settings
  • Web wallpapers can be placed by hand on the preview: switch on Transform, then drag, pinch and rotate the page
  • A wallpaper change crossfades instead of cutting; showing and hiding the monitor overlay animates too
  • A global shortcut opens the settings window, default ⌃⇧,

Improvements

  • The detail page is rebuilt: the wallpaper's name and its playback, scale and frame-rate controls sit on the preview itself, and the inspector keeps only what the preview cannot show
  • Library pages lose their in-page header — the page name lives in the toolbar and search sits under it, so the grid starts higher. Bookmarks and Schemes share one page behind a capsule, and tile size is a global setting
  • Scene pages show only the badges that differ between scenes, and the preset block has a permanent save button
  • Loading a scene no longer re-derives the same shader dozens of times; the "unlimited" frame rate follows the display's own refresh rate
  • Buttons, search fields and cards that play the same role now share one component, so they look and behave alike everywhere

Bug Fixes

  • "Remind Me Later" in the update dialog no longer reports the app as up to date
  • After an in-place update, the previous version's system-wallpaper extension could keep running and be reported as "in use"; it now retires itself, and the app ignores its keep-alive beats
  • A display change during a wallpaper crossfade could leave the outgoing wallpaper window behind over the new one

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
